description: This file defines a Java interface named Trigger for voice recognition functionalities within the com.google.android.voiceime package. It declares methods to start voice recognition with a specified language and to notify when the input view has started.

classes.name: Trigger
classes.description: An interface for triggering voice recognition and input view notifications.

methods.name: startVoiceRecognition
methods.description: Starts voice recognition for a specified language.

methods.name: onStartInputView
methods.description: Notifies that the input view has started.
